settings.subtitle: DESIGNED IN VIETNAM · RELEASED IN LIMITED EDITIONS
settings.paragraph_1: PHAM (Profound Human Authentic Mastery) is an independent label founded in Vietnam in 2026. We focus on restrained form, considered volume and purposeful detail.
settings.paragraph_2: We develop one edition at a time. Each design is sampled, refined and documented before release.
settings.founder_body: Coffee Pham founded PHAM at sixteen in 2026, while still in school. He started without investors, a team or industry contacts.
settings.edition_body: PHAM-001 is a cropped bomber with structured panels, mesh shoulders and adjustable straps. The lookbook shows a development sample. Final details may change.
settings.edition_note_value: 50 PLANNED OBJECTS · INDIVIDUALLY IDENTIFIED · NO RESTOCK
settings.founder_body_2: He learned through sampling, factory collaboration and building the storefront independently.
settings.edition_body_2: Edition 01 is planned for 50 numbered jackets, with no restock. The planned package includes an identity card and a commemorative pendant: 49 silver-tone finishes and one gold-tone. Neither finish is solid precious metal.
settings.edition_body_3: Refer to the Product, Size Guide and Edition Details pages for the latest specifications and release conditions. These take precedence over earlier campaign images.

settings.title: ONE OBJECT AT A TIME
settings.body: We focus development on a defined release rather than producing constant seasonal drops.

settings.title: DETAIL WITH A PURPOSE
settings.body: Cut, panels, mesh and hardware are considered together so each element serves the silhouette.

settings.title: SAMPLED AND REVIEWED
settings.body: Physical samples are examined for proportions, construction and finishing before production decisions.

settings.title: A CLEAR EDITION RECORD
settings.body: The first planned run is 50 individually identified jackets, with release information documented for buyers.
